description: Task Board API (Python, Flask): six routes work; the priority is not validated, deleting an unknown id answers 204 and the open count is wrong.

claims.text: POST /tasks creates a task and refuses a missing title with 400
POST /tasks refuses a priority that is not a whole number from 1 to 5 with 400
GET /tasks lists tasks, filters with ?done=true or false and sorts by priority, highest first
PATCH /tasks/<id> renames a task and refuses an empty title with 400
POST /tasks/<id>/complete marks a task done and answers 404 for an unknown id
DELETE /tasks/<id> answers 404 for an id that does not exist
GET /stats returns the correct total, done and open counts
